syllabus_extract: Role of I-band transponder. In ASW Operation.
specific_objectives: 18.1.4.1 Trainee will be able to appraise the function of secondary radars in ASW operation.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Review of I-band transponder function in ASW context using L & Ds and IB; Instructor supervision required for query resolution.
intro_questions: What is the primary function of a transponder in aircraft systems?
How does a secondary radar system differ from a primary radar system?
Why is the I-band frequency preferred for transponder operations in ASW?

development.content:
Definition of I-band transponder
Interaction with ASW secondary radar
Data link protocols in ASW
Identification Friend or Foe (IFF) modes
Response mechanisms to interrogations

Role in target identification
Cooperation with ASW sonobuoys
Data fusion in ASW operations
Tracking and classification of contacts
Mitigation of false alarms

topics: Future trends in ASW radar tech
development.content:
Operational limitations in ASW
Interference management techniques
Maintenance implications for ASW readiness
Integration with combat management systems
Future trends in ASW radar tech

summary_questions: Explain how the I-band transponder aids in distinguishing friendly from hostile aircraft during ASW operations.
Describe the specific role of the transponder in data fusion with sonobuoy arrays.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note on how the concepts learned in this lesson will be applied in the next lesson regarding the basic block diagram of the I-band transponder.
